dialogue.text: The year was 2022 and Guane Avenue was at its busiest time of the year!
Everyone was out getting items for themselves to bring home at the local Quick and Grab store in time for Summer break.
However, we will focus on two customers, or should I say, four?
Alright Jembi, just a few more packs and then we'll be off now!
Yeah I know, I'm grabbing as many as I can hold!
You don't look it, silly!
Shussssshhhh nobody caressss...
Suddenly, a distant conversation can be heard next isle...
Yeah I still don't get why you would want to rap some stran-
Aye, aren't you the blue guy from that one rhythym game?
Why yes I am!
ow as you can see here, boyfriend doesn't want to move on. Instead, I'll let you figure out what happens next...
Babe, no. We were just talking about this...
Aw but come on! If we keep rapping other people, they might just drop a small update for our game!
Honey, I don't care on what they do with that little funkin' game of theirs.
For all I know, they could just cancel the game and I'd be happy as ever!
Come on what's so bad about it?
See? You don't understand how embarrassing it is seeing my family portrayed as the bad guys!
Like just because you agreed, doesn't mean that me and my family have to be in the game aswell.
Wait? So actually, you're the guy from that funkin game that I suppose?
Yep!
I'm kinda interested on how my singing skills are like honestly. Like I tried before but I couldn't get myself to like it.
I wonder why.
Well don't be recording anything. I don't want my image to get involved with this in real life.
I'll make sure of it!
Sure...
